text: Surrounded by glass walls and people engrossed in their work, I sense a quiet anticipation, heightened by the ticking countdown on the screen. Entering the adjacent room, vibrant colors and innovative displays stimulate my curiosity and intellect. I feel as if I am at the intersection of creativity and disciplined research, witnessing the forging of ideas that could shape the future. It is invigorating but also humbling—a reminder of the endless pursuit of knowledge.
